senses.gloss: ch. same, to reach, be able; to master.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 114b:3">B. Mets. 114ᵇ</cite> <he>בארבעה לא מָצִינָא וכ׳</he> I could not master four orders of the Talmud, how could I master six?—Ib. 14ᵃ, a. fr. <he>מָצֵי אמר ליה</he> he may say to him.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 84a">B. Bath. 84ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="L00003"><he>לא</he></cite> (<he>הוה</he>) <he>מָצִית הדרת בך</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) thou wouldst not have had the right to retract; <he>השתא … מצית וכ׳</he> now that thou hast overreached me, canst thou retract?; a. fr.
<cite ref="Ketubot 62a">Keth. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>לא אי׳ נכרי וכ׳</he> the gentile did not succeed in keeping pace with him.
<cite ref="Nedarim 89b:6">Ned. 89ᵇ</cite> <he>רהיט … ולא אמ׳ למיתנא</he> he tried his utmost (v. <cite ref="C01197"><he>גַּפָּא</he> I</cite>), but had no success in his studies; a. e.

senses.gloss: (with נפשיה, or without) to place one’s self within sight of an enemy so as to give him a chance for reconciliation, to be ready for reconciliation.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 87a">Yoma 87ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה מַמְצִיא נפשיה</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; ed. <he>וממציא ליה</he>).—[<cite ref="Ketubot 60b">Keth. 60ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="M01675"><he>מְמַצְּיָא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="M02309"><he>מְצִי</he> II</cite>.]
